_comment: Whole-word spoken-text substitutions, e.g. "Kalimdor": "Kalimdore". Deliberately empty: every entry is a claim that the model mispronounces a word, and that claim can only be made after listening. Add rules from what a take actually sounds like, not from guesswork. Keys beginning with _ are ignored. Changing a rule changes the text hash, so the lines it affects correctly become --stale and can be re-cut from /zones on the site. Prefer a phoneme entry in wow-voiceover's shared dictionary: it fixes the sound without rewriting the text.
